newsitem.title: USA: Coke Enterprises ups Coke Canada offer to C$22/shr.
newsitem.headline: Coke Enterprises ups Coke Canada offer to C$22/shr.

text.p: Coca-Cola Enterprises said on Friday it will increase its offer for the 52 percent of Coca-Cola Beverages Ltd held by the public to C$22 per share from C$19.50 per share.

Coke Enterprises said in a news release that a Coke Canada board of directors special committee has determined that the higher offer is fair to public share owners, and the full board has accepted that determination.
Coke Enterprises said it plans to mail a tender offer to Coke Canada shareholders the week of August 11.

Coke Enterprises previously announced it was acquiring the 48 percent of Coke Canada held by Coca-Cola Co, as well as Coca-Cola Co's 49 percent stake in Coca-Cola Bottling Co of New York. Those deals should close late next week, Coke Enterprises said.
